key_insight: Ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes can support fast, parallel logical operations by exploiting code symmetries, enabling low-overhead fault-tolerant computation.
engineering_relevance: This work provides practical protocols for reducing spacetime overhead in quantum architectures, making high-rate error-corrected logic more hardware-efficient.
method: Partition logical qubits into symmetry-defined orbits.
Use parallel surgery to perform group-invariant logical Pauli-product measurements across orbits.
Apply chain-map convolution to improve spatial and temporal distances while keeping overhead low.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports distance-preserving gadgets for [[256, 68, 12]], [[576, 148, 18]], and [[1152, 580, 12]] codes, with about 2.5× space overhead and only 3–4 rounds of syndrome extraction.
watch_item: Programmability is constrained by subgroup restrictions, so greater logical control can require more spacetime resources.
paper_title: Efficient Logic with Ultra-High-Rate Quantum Codes
